instruction_units.title: 1. LH Chord Landing
instruction_units.instruction: The left hand sounds Ab3-Ab3-Eb4-Gb4-C5 (5 notes, span 16 semitones) on m.26, beat 4.

instruction_units.title: 2. Melody with accompaniment
instruction_units.instruction: Both hands form a melody-with-accompaniment texture at m.25-26: one layer carries the melodic line while another supplies aligned support. Melody Db5-Ab6 over accompaniment E4-Ab6.

instruction_units.title: 3. Melody Voicing over Accompaniment
instruction_units.instruction: The texture presents a melody voicing over accompaniment at m.25-26: the upper line projects while lower tones provide harmonic support. Melody Db5-Ab6 over accompaniment E4-Ab6.
